nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: The patent office wrote back. My patents are mine again — every one Vane's lawyers 'borrowed'. I've read the letter eleven times and it improves with each pass.

choices.text: Frame it next to Weatherby's deed.

nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: A door-unsqueaker that finally ships, a better windmill for the farms, and — don't laugh — a self-winding version of your watch. The future's loud, Cole. I intend to oil it.

nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: Already measured the wall. There's a spot left over. About ledger-sized.
